user.title: Set up ekey net
user.description: Enter the UDP port on which Home Assistant should receive the event packets from your ekey net system. In ekey net admin, set the IP address of this Home Assistant host and the same port as the UDP packet recipient, then run "Send changes to devices".

abort.already_configured: This UDP port is already configured.

init.title: ekey net options
init.description: Fine-tune decoding and link ekey users to Home Assistant persons. Saving reloads the integration.

data_description.user_map: One mapping per line, e.g. "46 = person.anna". Links ekey user IDs to Home Assistant persons.
data_description.name_map: Fallback display name per user ID, e.g. "46 = Anna".
